parameters.seed_policy: Use committed seeds or the custodian seed; never reselect after output.

measurement_procedure: In disposable exact-SHA clones, retain environment and raw stdout/stderr for base-interpreter environment/cleanliness preflight and postflight checks, locked non-editable sync, lock-frozen isolated non-editable tool and Python execution, lint, TeX source validation, full tests, six examples, semantic artifact validation, two pdflatex passes, and ten frozen mutations.
uncertainty_procedure: Command exits, test counts, structure, mutation rejection, Python environment-variable absence, preflight tracked/untracked/ignored Git cleanliness, isolated non-editable environment use, and postflight startup-surface equality are exact. Numeric drift uses only the committed semantic-checker tolerances.
statistical_analysis: Pass only if both platforms succeed at the exact candidate, PYTHONPATH, PYTHONHOME, VIRTUAL_ENV, and UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT are unset, a base interpreter performs the preflight and postflight, preflight reports no tracked, untracked, or ignored residue, locked sync and every uv-run command use --no-editable, every uv-run command also uses --isolated --frozen, postflight reports no tracked or untracked residue and exactly the non-editable locked project's expected .pth and customize startup surface, Windows builds a nonempty PDF, regeneration is contract-equivalent, all corruptions are rejected, and no required result exists only in an agent summary. Missing commands, surviving mutations, an editable install, a pre-existing or substituted environment, an unexpected or changed startup surface, any forbidden repository residue, undeclared import state, or a platform-only result are failures.

mutation_plan: Add an unregistered noninformational check identity; require rejection.
Flip a required check pass outcome; require rejection.
Change a measurement array shape; require rejection.
Change a stable configuration beyond tolerance; require rejection.
Make a required visual empty and untracked; require both defects.
Move a sensitive scientific diagnostic beyond its frozen threshold; require rejection.
Activate an untracked sitecustomize.py through PYTHONPATH; require base-interpreter preflight or postflight rejection.
Preplant an ignored .venv startup hook before locked sync; require ignored-state preflight rejection and startup-hook postflight rejection.
Inject an executable .pth startup hook after locked sync; require isolated frozen commands to ignore it and startup-surface postflight to reject it.
Make the editable project .pth self-clean after execution; require non-editable sync and isolated non-editable execution to eliminate that startup surface.
